tests.name: reconcileRound produces exactly one ReconciliationResult per entry in priorFindings, keyed by that finding's own id

cases.title: reconcileRound produces exactly one ReconciliationResult per entry in priorFindings, keyed by that finding's own id

titles.title: reconcileRound produces exactly one ReconciliationResult per entry in priorFindings, keyed by that finding's own id
reconcileRound's parameters are reviewId and the two finding sets only -- no ReviewTargets-shaped parameter exists anywhere in its signature, so no re-grounding input is even possible
ReconciliationResult's exported shape contains exactly priorFindingRef and verdict, with no severity, blocking, or gate-facing field of any kind
ReconciliationVerdict accepts exactly the four fixed verdicts (confirmed, still-open, contradicted, no-longer-surfaced) and rejects any other value at compile time
a rejecting reconcileRound call propagates its rejection rather than returning partial or fabricated results
priorFindings as an empty array returns an empty array, not an error
two priorFindings entries with identical category and severity but different id values still produce two separate ReconciliationResult entries, keyed by their distinct ids

when the two finding sets alone do not resolve a classification, reconcileRound reads the audit trail itself from .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/, rather than requiring the caller to have pre-extracted and passed it in
a reviewId containing a path-traversal segment is rejected before any filesystem access, rather than being joined into the audit-trail path unvalidated
two findings sharing category and severity but with different ids are NOT treated as a recurrence -- only a matching id is unambiguous
outside any bound request, with no registered repo for the process cwd, the audit trail and the classify provider fall back to the process's own INSRC_REPO
the registered repo for the request's cwd wins over its own envRepo pin -- the canonical precedence, not envRepo-first
when neither a registered repo for cwd nor an envRepo/INSRC_REPO pin resolves, reconcileRound rejects rather than silently defaulting to cwd
a symlinked review directory pointing outside .insrc/tmp is not followed -- its audit trail is never read
a symlinked audit-trail.json pointing outside .insrc/tmp is not followed -- its target content is never read
review A's own directory aliased (via symlink) to sibling review B's genuine directory is rejected -- B's audit trail never reaches A's classification
review A's own audit-trail.json aliased (via symlink) to sibling review B's genuine audit-trail.json is rejected
reconcileRound and ReconciliationResult
